notes: 1.3.36: the picture judge sits beside the speech engine only when the card has room for both. The same round-down as the engine ladder: the engine's peak (12 GiB), the transcriber (2) and the judge (5) plus a spare must fit. A 24 GB card has that room, so the footage is fetched while the voice records, as before; on a 16 or 20 GB card the footage waits for the voice to finish and the judge then has the card to itself. The run prints which it is; providers.vision.beside_voice (auto, always, never) overrides it. Also in this line: the judge itself (1.3.34) and an update keeping your settings (1.3.35).
